title: The Hunting Wives Creator Defends Major Season 2 Death: 'It's Important That Things Have Consequences'
summary: The second season of Netflix's The Hunting Wives loses a major character in Episode 5. Creator Rebecca Perry Sutter tells TVLine why it had to happen.
